articles.title: Bitcoin nears $80,000, but analysts say the next pullback will be key
articles.snippet: Analysts say consolidation could strengthen bitcoin’s rally, while thin trading above $80,000 may set up sharper price moves.

articles.title: BNB Chain activates Pasteur hard fork to strengthen bridge security
articles.snippet: BNB Chain activates the Pasteur hard fork on BSC, closing bridge and validator security gaps while targeting greater transaction capacity.

articles.title: Wall Street and Washington Fuel Bitcoin Rally: Here's What's Going On
articles.snippet: Institutional buying, improving macro conditions and a friendlier regulatory outlook are supporting Bitcoin's rally, while billions in short liquidations have accelerated the move.

articles.title: Washington Goes All-In on Crypto: Trump Pushes Clarity, SEC Rules, and CFTC Warnings
articles.snippet: Trump urged executives to pass a "fair version" of the Clarity Act, the CFTC warned it would write its own rules if the bill stalls, and the SEC abruptly advanced its first crypto fundraising framework.

articles.title: Bitcoin Climbs Higher as $1.2 Billion in Shorts Liquidated
articles.snippet: The largest cryptocurrency surged 7.9% in a day to around $77,000, triggering a short squeeze that wiped out roughly $1.21 billion in bearish bets amid a wave of favorable news from Washington.
